Summary: Investigate changes in racial self-identification 


```{r}
library(here)
library(vroom)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(broom)
source(here("code", "helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
numident <- vroom(here("data", "censoc_numident_w_initials.csv.zip"), col_select = c("HISTID", "middle_A", "middle_B", "byear", "INCWAGE", "death_age", "SEX", "EDUC", "RACE", "RELATE", "MARST", "SEI", "link_abe_exact_conservative", "race_first"), progress = T) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()


## Select First letter of middle name (census)
numident$middle_name_census <- get_first_letter_lower(numident$middle_a)
numident$middle_name_numident <- get_first_letter_lower(numident$middle_b)
```


```{r}
numident <- numident %>% 
  mutate(race_numident = case_when(
    race_first == 1 ~ "White",
    race_first == 2 ~ "Black"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(race_census = case_when(
    race == 100 ~ "White",
    race == 200 ~ "Black"
  )) %>% 
  filter(sex == 1)
  
```


```{r}
numident %>% 
  filter(byear %in% c(1910:1920)) %>% 
  filter(race_census == "Black") %>% 
  group_by(link_abe_exact_conservative) %>% 
  summarize(mean(race_numident == "White", na.rm = T))
```

```{r}
  summarize(mean(middle_name_census == middle_name_numident)) %>%

  filter(race_census == "Black") %>% 
  summarize(mean(race_numident == "White", na.rm = T)) %>% 
  pull()


R_true <- (R_obs - R_false * f_r) / (1 - f_r)
```

```{r}
adjust_passing_rate <- function(data, birth_year_range = 1910:1920, conservative = F) {
  
  filtered <- data %>%
    filter(byear %in% birth_year_range)
  
  # Estimate false match rate
  false_match_rate <- filtered %>%
    filter(!is.na(middle_name_census) & !is.na(middle_name_numident)) %>%
    summarize(match = mean(middle_name_census == middle_name_numident)) %>%
    pull()
  
  f_r <- 1 - false_match_rate
  
  # R_false: passing rate among likely false matches
  if (conservative == T) {
  R_false <- filtered %>%
    filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 1) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(middle_name_census) & !is.na(middle_name_numident)) %>%
    filter(middle_name_census != middle_name_numident) %>%
    filter(race_census == "Black") %>%
    summarize(rate = mean(race_numident == "White", na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull() } else {
    R_false <- filtered %>%
    filter(!is.na(middle_name_census) & !is.na(middle_name_numident)) %>%
    filter(middle_name_census != middle_name_numident) %>%
    filter(race_census == "Black") %>%
    summarize(rate = mean(race_numident == "White", na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull() 
    }
  
  # R_obs: observed passing rate in full Black sample
    R_obs <- filtered %>%
    filter(race_census == "Black") %>%
    summarize(rate = mean(race_numident == "White", na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull()
  
  # Bias-corrected true passing rate
  R_true <- (R_obs - R_false * f_r) / (1 - f_r)
  
  return(data.frame(
    R_true = R_true,
    R_obs = R_obs,
    R_false = R_false,
    f_r = f_r,
    adjustment_factor = R_true / R_obs
  ))
}
```


```{r}
result <- adjust_passing_rate(numident, conservative = F)

result_conservative <- adjust_passing_rate(numident %>% filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 1))
```


```{r}
bootstrap_adjust_passing_rate <- function(data, n_boot = 100, birth_year_range = 1910:1920) {
  
  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    total = n_boot,
    format = "Bootstrapping [:bar] :percent in :elapsed"
  )
  
  results <- tibble(R_true = numeric(), R_obs = numeric())

  for (i in 1:n_boot) {
    pb$tick()
    
    sample_data <- data %>%
      slice_sample(n = nrow(data), replace = TRUE)
    
    res <- tryCatch({
      adjust_passing_rate(sample_data, birth_year_range)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(res)) {
      results <- add_row(results, R_true = res$R_true, R_obs = res$R_obs)
    }
  }
  
  results %>%
    summarize(
      adj_mean = mean(R_true),
      adj_lower_ci = quantile(R_true, 0.025),
      adj_upper_ci = quantile(R_true, 0.975),
      obs_mean = mean(R_obs),
      obs_lower_ci = quantile(R_obs, 0.025),
      obs_upper_ci = quantile(R_obs, 0.975)
    )
}
```



```{r}
library(progress)

# Full sample bootstrap
bootstrap_result <- bootstrap_adjust_passing_rate(numident)

# Conservative link sample bootstrap
bootstrap_result_conservative <- bootstrap_adjust_passing_rate(
  numident %>% filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 1))

bootstrap_result_standard_not_conservative <- bootstrap_adjust_passing_rate(
  numident %>% filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 0))
```



```{r}
bootstrap_result <- bootstrap_result %>% 
  mutate(link_method = "ABE Standard")

bootstrap_result_conservative <- bootstrap_result_conservative %>% 
  mutate(link_method = "ABE Conservative")

bootstrap_result_standard_not_conservative <- bootstrap_result_standard_not_conservative %>% 
  mutate(link_method = "ABE Standard, Not Conservative")

bootstrap_result_conservative

fastlink <- data.frame(adj_mean = 0.069988233,
      adj_lower_ci = 0.06423506,
      adj_upper_ci = 0.075646609,
      obs_mean = 0.225058437,
      obs_lower_ci = 0.221697057,
      obs_upper_ci = 0.228326108) %>% 
    mutate(link_method = "Fastlink")

  
results <- bind_rows(bootstrap_result, bootstrap_result_conservative, fastlink, bootstrap_result_standard_not_conservative)

results_long <- results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("adj_"):starts_with("obs_"),
    names_to = c("type", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(adj|obs)_(.*)"
  )

results_long_filter <- results_long %>% 
  filter(link_method %in% c("ABE Conservative", "Fastlink"))  

mean_adj <- results_long_filter %>% 
  filter(type == "adj") %>% 
  summarize(mean(mean)) %>% pull()

passing_fig <- results_long %>% 
    mutate(type = recode(type, adj = "Adjusted", obs = "Observed")) %>% 
 # filter(link_method %in% c("ABE Conservative", "Fastlink"))  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = link_method, y = mean, ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci, color = type)) +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), size = 1) +
  labs(
    y = "Passing Rate",
    x = "Linking Method",
    color = "Estimate Type"
  ) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() + 
  ylim(0, .5) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank()) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_adj, linetype = "dashed") + 
  ggsci::scale_color_lancet()
  

ggsave(plot = passing_fig, filename = here("figures", "passing_fig.png"), bg = "white", height = 4.5, width = 9)
```
